hypothesis: Qwen3-4B may remain stable between early and late evidence positions at 8,192 and 16,384 requested tokens when tested on fresh independent cases.
null_result: Qwen has no measurable early-versus-late position effect at the tested resolution; perfect observed accuracy is bounded fresh-case evidence, not proof of universal reliability.

model_scope.rationale: This is a Qwen-only confirmatory control for ECC-003's 20-case perfect result. Llama is historical ECC-004 comparison only; this is neither production selection nor a ranking.

case_generation.record_template: Registry entry: Project {entity} has access code {answer}.
case_generation.freshness_contract: Target entities and codes are unique and do not overlap ECC-002, ECC-003, or ECC-004.

interpretation.stable: absolute early-minus-late gap <= 0.10 and neither directional paired transition exceeds the other by four or more cases
interpretation.possible_position_sensitivity: early exceeds late but stable conditions do not hold
interpretation.position_sensitivity_observed: early-minus-late >= 0.10 and early-pass/late-fail >= 4 and exceeds reverse
